fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: The fund generally invests at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index (i.e., depositary receipts representing securities of the underlying index) and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents.

news.paragraph: Recent analysis of the iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM) highlights a mixed outlook, with some analysts suggesting small caps are benefiting from an AI spending boom while others caution that the recent run-up may represent a dangerous trade. Pivot point analysis indicates potential market turning points, but the overall sentiment remains divided on whether IWM is still a buy. The ETF's performance is being closely watched as the market grapples with the sustainability of small-cap gains.
